{\footnotesize\raggedright E5: the seasonal lag $y_{T-12}$ is added to the 37 predictors of Ridge, ElasticNet and XGB-37, with the same hyperparameter search and seeds. Differences: E5 $-$ original (negative = E5 better), paired 95\% bootstrap CI. $y_{T-12}$ only: E5 $-$ original refitted on the same training rows (E5 loses the five targets 2016-08 to 2016-12), which isolates the effect of the new predictor. Seeds E5 better: XGB-37 seeds (of 10) whose MAE improves; Ridge and ElasticNet are deterministic. MAE in tonnes; 95\% CI: paired bootstrap of months within each test window (B = 10,000, seed 42). All results in this table are post-protocol analyses (second review round) and do not modify the pre-registered ten-model ranking.\par}
